primary_responsibility: Manages user authentication workflows and session lifecycle, including credential verification, secure token generation, and session validation.

functional_group_candidates.name: User Authentication
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Securely verify user identity and track login activity
business_rules: User must exist in the system to authenticate
Password must match the stored hash using SHA-256
Last login timestamp must be updated upon successful authentication

functional_group_candidates.name: Session Management
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Maintain and validate secure user sessions for persistent access
business_rules: Session tokens must be cryptographically secure (URL-safe)
Validation requires the session to be non-expired relative to current UTC time
